description_en: Modifies the attributes of an IP address pool by calling the UpdatePublicIpAddressPoolAttribute operation
kebab_example: aliyun vpc update-public-ip-address-pool-attribute --public-ip-address-pool-id pippool-6wetvn6fumkgycssx0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdatePublicIpAddressPoolAttribute

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPAM pool
parameters.name: public_ip_address_pool_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IP address pool.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
地址池实例的名称。

名称长度为0-128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the IP address pool.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
地址池实例的描述。

长度为0-256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without modifying the IP address pool attributes. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and then sends the request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改地址池属性。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the IP address pool to modify
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的IP地址池所在的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
